_what_this_is: the discover step's proposals (model call); the confirm step looks each up in the registries

proposals.title: Digital tracking, provider decision support systems, and targeted client communication via mobile devices to improve primary health care
proposals.why: Most recent Cochrane review (pub2) directly answering the question: tracking + CDSS + TCC via mobile devices in primary care.

proposals.title: Decision-support tools via mobile devices to improve quality of care in primary healthcare settings
proposals.why: Cochrane review of mobile CDSS (checklists, protocols, risk tools) used by primary healthcare workers; 8 studies included.

proposals.title: Targeted client communication via mobile devices for improving maternal, neonatal, and child health
proposals.why: Cochrane review of SMS/voice reminders to clients for MNCH outcomes; directly addresses patient-reminder component of the question.

proposals.title: Targeted client communication via mobile devices for improving sexual and reproductive health
proposals.why: Cochrane review of mobile TCC for sexual/reproductive health; complements MNCH review on patient reminder effects.

proposals.title: Clients' perceptions and experiences of targeted digital communication accessible via mobile devices for reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health: a qualitative evidence synthesis
proposals.why: Qualitative synthesis of patient perspectives on mobile reminder/communication programmes; informs acceptability and implementation.

proposals.title: WHO guideline: recommendations on digital interventions for health system strengthening
proposals.why: First WHO evidence-based guideline recommending digital tracking + CDSS and TCC via mobile devices for primary health care.

proposals.title: The Impact of mHealth Interventions: Systematic Review of Systematic Reviews
proposals.why: Umbrella review of 23 systematic reviews (371 studies) on mHealth effectiveness across conditions and care processes.

proposals.title: Effectiveness of Single-Component Clinician Reminder Systems for Smoking and Obesity Preventive Care in Primary Care: A Systematic Review
proposals.why: 2025 systematic review and meta-analysis of clinician-facing reminder systems for preventive care in primary care settings.
